name: Boss Monster
summary: Dungeon-building card game where players lure heroes to kill for souls while avoiding wounds.
rules_text: Each player is a Boss with a linear dungeon. Decks of Room, Spell, and Hero cards are shuffled; hero count scales with players. Each boss gets random Boss card, draws 5 Rooms and 2 Spells, discards 2. Each turn has phases: Reveal one Hero per player to Town. Each player draws a Room. Build: in XP order, each may place one Room face-down either leftmost or on top of existing room; Ordinary Rooms can cover any, Advanced Rooms must share a treasure type. Reveal builds together. Bait: each Hero goes to player with highest total of its treasure type across visible rooms and boss. Adventure: Heroes enter owner's dungeon left to right, taking each room's damage cumulatively; if damage >= Health, Hero dies and becomes Souls face-down (1 for ordinary, 2 for epic). If survives all rooms, Hero stays face-up as Wounds (1 or 2). Spells marked for Build or Adventure may be played by any player on their turn. First to 10 Souls wins; player with 5 Wounds loses immediately. Tie broken by lowest Boss XP.
unmapped: linear dungeon traversal with cumulative damage
soul vs wound thresholds with epic double values
rating_reason: Card dungeon building, luring heroes, strategic and text-expressible.
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
